einzeiler: Discussion on the history and novel of the Three Kingdoms period.
kurzfassung: An appearance on the Total War podcast discussing the Three Kingdoms era. The conversation covers the historical background, the related novel, and its adaptation into a game. Insights are shared on how the development team captured the essence of the story.
stichpunkte: Discussion on the historical Three Kingdoms period
Exploration of the novel based on the era
Adaptation of history and literature into a game
Insights into the development process by the game production team
beschreibung: Back in February, I took part in a podcast conversation on the Invicta History YouTube channel with the host, Julien, and Peter Stewart, a writer from the team producing the coming “Total War: Three Kingdoms” game. We chatted for more than an hour, geeking out over the history of the Three Kingdoms period, the novel based on it, and how all of that is handled in the game. It was a fun conversation, and it was interesting for me to hear how the team worked to capture the essence of the story in the game. Have a listen.
